title: How is Augustus connected to Tom Cruise?
description:
Rome's first emperors, a Renaissance fresco, the line of popes and two Reagan-era photos connect Augustus to Tom Cruise.

Augustus → Nero → Saint Peter → Pope John Paul II → Nancy Reagan → Tom Cruise

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.
